training_config.schedule: linear warmup 100 iters then cosine to 5% of peak (stepped per iteration)
training_config.loss: cross entropy, ignore_index=255, no class weights
training_config.eval_split: val (all 1192 images); no test data used

decision_rule.primary: mean validation mIoU4 at iterations 3675 and 4900
decision_rule.reject: non-finite training loss at any point, OR validation mIoU3 drops by STRICTLY more than 0.05 between consecutive evaluations 2450->3675 or 3675->4900. The 1225->2450 pair is NOT checked.
decision_rule.reject_implementation: lr_pilot.miou3_rejections(); drops compared against 0.05 + 1e-9 so a drop of exactly 0.05 does not reject; a rejected candidate keeps training to the end (full curve recorded), is flagged rejected in its summary with the reason, and is excluded from selection. Non-finite loss stops the candidate immediately.
decision_rule.tie_break: if the top two primary scores differ by no more than 0.01: lower mean validation loss at 3675 and 4900; then the smaller LR
decision_rule.tie_threshold_note: 0.01 is a predeclared practical threshold; it is NOT derived from the measured loss noise (no mIoU variability has been measured)
decision_rule.big_rock: Big Rock IoU is reported separately and is not used alone to choose the LR
decision_rule.boundary: if the best LR is 3e-5 or 3e-4, an extension is proposed to the user and not run automatically

caveats: single seed; 4-epoch pilot may favour larger LRs than a 20-epoch run; it selects a sensible starting LR only
